text:
maya: Quick check — embeddings API: if a batch contains mixed types (strings + base64 blobs) and some items exceed max length, do we truncate per-item or reject the whole batch? prepping release notes for 2.8.
ryan: Per design doc we leaned toward per-item truncation + per-item warnings. But need to confirm behavior for empty inputs. @olivia?
olivia: Prefer explicit error for empty string items (return null embedding + warning) — zeros confuse downstream QA. For over-limit items: truncate and include warning `truncated_to_n_chars`.
samir: Ops prefers per-item truncate too (fewer retries). Also concerned about HTTP semantics for partial failures — do we use 200 with per-item statuses or a 207/206?
maya: We don't have multi-status at infra level. Proposal: 200 with `data` array containing per-item `status` + `embedding` or null. Example:
```
{
 "data": [
  {"id":0, "status":"ok", "embedding":[...], "warnings":[]},
  {"id":1, "status":"empty_input", "embedding":null, "warnings":["empty_input"]}
 ]
}
```
ryan: Add an opt-in header `X-Embedding-Policy: per-item-truncate-v1` so clients can detect behavior. Also include deprecation plan if we change default in future.
dev-bot: CI: PR #4578 — tests for mixed batch shapes; all checks passed :white_check_mark:
olivia: Backwards-compat note: some older SDKs assume `data` is always list of vectors (no nulls). Suggest query param `strict=true` to make API 400 on invalid items; default remains lenient (returns per-item statuses).
samir: I'll open a docs+SDK follow-up issue to add examples and migration notes. @maya can you add Python/TS SDK tests and CHANGELOG blurb?
maya: Yes — will add tests, update SDK adapters to parse `status` fields, and include example of `warnings` messages. I'll also add an explicit note that embedding length truncation is per-item and the truncation boundary is reported in the warning.
ryan: LGTM. Please include a short note in the release checklist to ping support and customers with high-volume embeddings usage.
maya: Will do. Thanks. :thumbsup:
